title: Upload processed Forge images to Pinata (pixel mode + configured dimensions)

requirements.text: Ensure Forge “Direct Injection” image uploads are processed into a new square PNG at the project’s configured output dimensions before being saved into project state (so the stored image matches what the app displays). Processing must: (1) resize to exactly project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize, and (2) apply pixel mode by disabling canvas image smoothing when project.pixelArtMode is enabled.

quotes: the file uploaded to Pinata always be the processed version (Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions), matching what the user sees in the app.

acceptanceCriteria: When a user uploads a 1:1 image via Forge > Direct Injection, the resulting saved token imageData is a PNG data URL whose intrinsic pixel dimensions equal project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize.
If project.pixelArtMode is enabled, the processing step uses a canvas with imageSmoothingEnabled=false so the output is pixelated rather than anti-aliased.
The Forge gallery display continues to work and shows the processed image.

requirements.text: Discard the original, unprocessed uploaded file once processing is complete: do not persist original dimensions or original image bytes in project.customTokens or any other long-lived project state used for export/upload.
acceptanceCriteria: After Direct Injection, project.customTokens contains only the processed (resized/pixel-mode) imageData for each injected token.
Refreshing/reloading the app does not restore any original (pre-processed) Direct Injection image variant because it was never persisted.

requirements.text: Verify the IPFS/Pinata upload pipeline uses the processed images for any NFTs originating from Forge uploads by ensuring the imageData that flows into uploadCollectionToIPFS (project.generatedNFTs[*].imageData) is the processed Forge output rather than the original upload data URL.

quotes: the file uploaded to Pinata always be the processed version (Pixel Mode + configured Dimensions)

acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a collection to Pinata results in image files whose intrinsic pixel dimensions match project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize for Forge-upload-derived NFTs.
No Pinata-uploaded image for Forge-upload-derived NFTs retains the original uploaded pixel dimensions.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend.immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not change the Pinata API endpoints or authentication method.
Do not add new backend storage or change backend state/schema for this fix.
